source: MacBook Air (M1, 2020): 8 CPU cores, default scaled display 1440x900 at 2x (Apple specifications). Chrome on macOS sends a frozen Intel Mac OS X user agent. The adapter description 'Apple M1' is the string the app's own comment assumes, not a reading from a Mac; the buffer limits mirror the Dawn values measured on the NVIDIA card. No Mac was available. User agent follows the shape current Chrome sends (reduced UA); the version number is illustrative.
